turns.message: How many days do I have to send something back?
turns.reply: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and Fernwick Plus members have 60 days [6]. If you received the wrong item, you have 14 days to send it back [1].

turns.message: what does express delivery cost
turns.reply: Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs $14.95 [1].

turns.message: Is there a spend threshold for free shipping?
turns.reply: Standard shipping is free on orders of $50 or more, after discounts [1].

turns.message: If I order at 4pm today will it go out today?
turns.reply: Orders placed before 2:00 PM Eastern Time on a business day ship the same day, so an order at 4pm would miss that cut-off [1]. Orders placed after that time ship the next business day [1].

turns.message: I just placed an order and want to cancel it. How long do I have?
turns.reply: You can cancel an order yourself within 60 minutes of placing it by opening Account, then Orders, and selecting Cancel [1]. After 60 minutes the order has usually gone to the warehouse and can no longer be changed [1].

turns.message: Do you deliver to Canada, and how long does it take?
turns.reply: We ship to Canada [2]. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and costs $24.95 per order [2]. Import duties and taxes are not included in the price and are paid by the recipient on delivery [2].

turns.message: How much is gift wrap?
turns.reply: Gift wrapping costs $4.95 per item and is added at checkout [1].

turns.message: How do I start a return?
turns.reply: Open Account, then Orders, select the item and choose Return [1]. Print the prepaid label, pack the item, attach the label and drop the parcel at any carrier location [1]. You do not need to contact support to start a normal return [1].

turns.message: Do I have to pay to return an item that I simply don't want?
turns.reply: Yes, for a return of an item you simply don't want, a $6.95 label fee is deducted from your refund [3]. The fee is waived if you are a Fernwick Plus member or if you choose store credit [3].

turns.message: How long until my refund shows up after you receive the return?
turns.reply: We inspect returns within 2 business days of arrival and then issue the refund to your original payment method [1]. Banks usually take 5 to 10 business days to show it [1]. Store credit is available immediately after inspection [1].

turns.message: Can I return a gift card?
turns.reply: Gift cards cannot be returned [3].

turns.message: The lamp arrived smashed. What's the deadline to report it?
turns.reply: Damaged items must be reported within 7 days of delivery, with a photo of the item and the packaging [1]. We will then send a free replacement or give a full refund, your choice [1].

turns.message: How long is the warranty on your desks and chairs?
turns.reply: Fernwick-branded furniture has a 5 year warranty against manufacturing defects [1]. Other brands are covered by their maker's warranty instead [1].

turns.message: Which payment methods do you take?
turns.reply: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Fernwick gift cards [1]. We do not accept personal checks, cash on delivery or cryptocurrency [1]. Orders between $75 and $1,500 can also be split into 4 interest-free payments taken every 2 weeks [2].

turns.message: When will my card actually be charged?
turns.reply: Your card is authorised when you place the order and charged when the order ships [1]. For backordered and pre-order items, your card is charged when the item ships, not when you order [2].

turns.message: How do I change the card on my account?
turns.reply: Go to Account, then Payment methods, and select Add card or Remove [1]. To change the card used for your Fernwick Plus renewal, set the new card as Default [1].

turns.message: Why was my payment declined?
turns.reply: Payments are usually declined because the billing address does not match the one held by the bank, the card has expired, or the bank has blocked the purchase [1]. You can check your details, try another card or payment method, or ask your bank to approve the transaction [1].

turns.message: Do gift cards expire?
turns.reply: Gift cards never expire and have no fees [1].

turns.message: Can I use two promo codes on one order?
turns.reply: No, only one promo code can be used per order [1]. Codes also cannot be added after the order has been placed [1].

turns.message: I forgot my password, how long is the reset link good for?
turns.reply: The reset link is valid for 30 minutes [1].

turns.message: My account got locked after a few wrong passwords. How long do I wait?
turns.reply: Your account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts [1]. You can wait the 15 minutes or reset your password to unlock it right away [1].

turns.message: How do I turn on two factor authentication?
turns.reply: Turn on two-step verification under Account, then Security [1]. You can use an authenticator app or text message codes [1]. Save the 10 recovery codes shown during setup, because each code works once if you lose your phone [1].

turns.message: What's the yearly price of Plus?
turns.reply: Fernwick Plus costs $49 per year [1].

turns.message: How do I cancel my Fernwick Plus membership?
turns.reply: Go to Account, then Membership, then Cancel [1]. Your benefits continue until the end of the period you have paid for, and the membership does not renew [1].

turns.message: Is there a free trial for Plus and how long is it?
turns.reply: New members get a 30 day free trial [1]. Each household can use one trial [1].

turns.message: My standing desk shows E01 and won't move
turns.reply: Unplug the desk for 30 seconds, then plug it back in [1]. Next, hold the down button until the desk reaches its lowest point and beeps [1]. The desk is ready to use after the beep [1].

turns.message: What's the maximum weight the Rise desk can hold?
turns.reply: The Rise standing desk supports up to 120 kg (265 lb) [1].

turns.message: Will the monitor arm hold a 32 inch screen? What's the biggest it takes?
turns.reply: The Perch monitor arm fits screens up to 34 inches, so a 32 inch screen is within its limit [1]. The screen must also weigh no more than 9 kg (19.8 lb) and have a VESA 75 x 75 mm or 100 x 100 mm mount [1].

turns.message: How do I pair the Quill keyboard with my laptop?
turns.reply: Switch the keyboard on, then hold Fn and 1, 2 or 3 for 3 seconds until the light blinks [1]. Next, select Quill Keyboard in your laptop's Bluetooth settings [1]. The keyboard remembers up to 3 devices [1].

turns.message: people on calls can't hear me through the Murmur headset
turns.reply: Check that the mute switch on the left ear cup is off and that the headset is selected as the input device in your computer's sound settings [1]. If the microphone is still silent, update the headset firmware with the Murmur app [1]. For the update, connect the headset with its USB cable, keep it plugged in, and expect it to take about 5 minutes [2].

turns.message: What are your support opening hours on Saturday?
turns.reply: Our support team is available on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM [1].

turns.message: Is there a fee for returns?

turns.message: Why would a payment be declined?

turns.message: Will I be charged twice if my order ships in two parcels?
turns.reply: No, you will not be charged the shipping fee twice, since the shipping fee is charged only once when an order arrives in separate parcels [3]. Your card is charged when the order ships, after being authorised when you place the order [2].

turns.message: How do I spot a phishing email pretending to be you?
turns.reply: Fernwick Goods never asks for your password or full card number by email, text or phone, and official emails come from addresses ending in @fernwick.example [1]. If you receive a suspicious message, do not click its links; forward it to security@fernwick.example [1].

turns.message: How do I turn on two-step verification to keep my account safe?
turns.reply: Turn on two-step verification under Account, then Security, using either an authenticator app or text message codes [1]. Be sure to save the 10 recovery codes shown during setup, since each code works once if you lose your phone [1].

turns.message: How can I download my personal data?
turns.reply: Go to Account, then Privacy, then Download my data to request a copy of your account data [1]. The file is emailed to you within 7 days [1].

turns.message: How do I close my account?
turns.reply: You can close your account under Account, then Privacy, then Close account [1]. Closing becomes permanent after 30 days, and signing in during that time cancels the request [1]. Unused store credit is lost when the account is permanently closed [1].
